generated.title: LA Is Moving In With San Francisco… Really? #shorts
generated.description:
Los Angeles is moving in with San Francisco… in about 15 million years, if today's plate motion simply continued.

Along the San Andreas Fault System, the Pacific Plate moves northwest relative to the North American Plate at about 46 millimeters a year, so southwestern California is moving north. The old myth that California will fall into the ocean has no basis: USGS says there is nowhere for it to fall.

The 15-million-year figure is a USGS straight-line projection at today's rate, not a forecast. The map, fault trace, arrows and the accelerated Los Angeles move in this video are schematic illustrations, not data or footage.

Built to loop, so watch it again. The full Myth vs Fact version: https://youtu.be/8Zke9Kf1128

Part of the Earthquake Science Explained series. Subscribe to Next Huge Quake for more earthquake science.
